name: APBS
summary: Continuum electrostatics calculations for biomolecular systems.

steps: Read the official APBS download instructions and registration request before choosing a local installation route.
Select the maintainer's platform-specific release archive, then check OS, runtime libraries, archive contents, and any checksum supplied by the maintainer.
Extract into a user-controlled location and keep the APBS executable and libraries together; do not edit shell startup files or system-wide paths automatically.
install.verify_note: Use the official installation guide's command-line and example checks in the chosen location; do not submit structures to the optional web server without user approval.

notes: The maintainer recommends precompiled binaries and requests user registration. Its web server is an alternative, not a local install.
